hardware.variant: Luckfox Lyra Zero W with 512 MiB DDR3 and 256 MiB Winbond SPI NAND.

scenario: Boot the factory system. From its UART console, read /sys/bus/usb/devices/1-1.1/descriptors and list /sys/class/net.
expected: Identify the radio and the interfaces and endpoints that the active factory system exposes.
observed: The radio reported a69c:88dc and configuration 1. The Bluetooth function grouped interfaces 0 and 1. Interface 2, alternate setting 0, had class ff/ff/ff and four bulk endpoints. The addresses were 0x01, 0x81, 0x02 and 0x82. All four had a maximum packet size of 512 bytes. The factory system exposed wlan0.
limits: The sample covers the radio after the factory driver initialized it. Its descriptors before firmware initialization require another measurement.
Chip silicon revision, EmberBSD driver attachment and Wi-Fi association require separate checks.
